note: Missouri River bottomland between Boonville and Rocheport, subject to seasonal flooding. The one camping spot on the area map is beside the gravel parking lot at the end of the area's gravel entrance road off Highway 40, on the area's northwest edge; the river is about a kilometre south. No amenities. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed MDC 'Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map... No amenities are provided... 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period'. Map (12/2/2024) shows one Primitive Camping symbol beside the P at the end of the improved road. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin (GIS 296) is ~20 m off the gravel lot it serves; fine. Not waterfront kept. PHONE differs: area page (573) 445-3882.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'. Brochure: 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas shown on map. These may or may not have defined campsites. No amenities are provided. Seasonal closures and restrictions may apply... Campers are limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period.' (Also: 'Camping is allowed by Missouri River boat travelers within 100 yards of the river between April 1 and Sept. 30' - boat-in only.) Map: one Primitive Camping symbol beside the parking lot at the end of the MDC improved road from Highway 40 (page: 'The area... is 0.625 mile down a gravel road'). Imagery: a gravel lot ~40 x 20 m at the end of the gravel spur with the camping point ~20 m SW on grass; a 23-ft rig fits. No ford, 4WD or rig wording. Area page: 'subject to seasonal flooding'.

PIN: stored 38.98215,-92.61639 = GIS point 296, on grass ~20 m SW of the gravel lot. Fine (lot 38.9823,-92.6160 if preferred). GIS 'parking lot' 890 is mis-placed 245 m E at the road bend, where imagery shows no lot.

PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 is the Columbia regional office on the 2022 brochure; the area page now reads 'For more information call (573) 445-3882'. Suggest 573-445-3882 (apply.py doesn't write phones).
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept): the camp is at the northwest edge of the area near Salt Creek's channel; the Missouri River is ~1 km south across fields and wetlands.
